Report-shape laundering treats a complete schema, polished packet, checklist, or documentation standard as proof that the underlying report or system is correct. Stale-snapshot currentness promotes historical work-board, registry, gate, readiness, or runtime metadata as a statement about the current project. Digest, path, revision, generator, command, environment, or dependency drift joins an imported fact to the wrong artifact or makes replay irreproducible.
